svg.title: Four behaviors near x = 1
svg.desc: Four small graphs near x = 1. First: a curve with an open circle at (1, 2) and a separate filled dot at (1, 3); the limit is 2 and the value 3 does not change it. Second: the graph jumps, approaching 1 from the left (open circle) and 3 from the right (filled dot); the one-sided limits differ, so there is no limit. Third: both sides shoot upward without bound beside a dashed vertical line at x = 1; no limit. Fourth: the graph wiggles faster and faster between 1 and 3 near x = 1 and never settles; no limit.

text.tspan: the value f(1) = 3 does not change it
from the left 1, from the right 3
the outputs never settle on one number
Four ways a graph can behave as x approaches 1
